title: A machine-learning tool to predict substrate-adaptive conditions for Pd-catalyzed C-N couplings.
summary: Models recommended conditions for out-of-sample C-N couplings; ten products were isolated in high yields. The result covers the tested reaction optimization and does not imply universal substrate coverage.
organization: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG

evidence.tested: Models recommended conditions for out-of-sample C-N couplings; ten products were isolated in high yields. Admit tested reaction optimization, without assuming universal substrate coverage.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Actively learned neural-network reaction models is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
